name: Midwife

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Birth center care package
services.story: The main story: the birth center care package. A $1,000 deposit when the care agreement is signed; the rest is paid at the visits, never charged on its own on a set day.

services.name: Meet the midwife (free consult)
services.story: The free meet-the-midwife consult: nothing is taken and nothing is to pay.

services.name: Well-person visit
services.story: A well-person visit: nothing taken when booking; the plan is billed, and any share is paid at the front desk. Self-pay: $180 at the visit.

services.name: Childbirth class series
services.story: The childbirth class series, paid in full when booking.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Priya (midwife) and Ruth (birth assistant), who visit with a scale and the birth supplies

services.name: Home birth care package
services.story: The main story: the home birth care package. A $1,000 deposit when the care agreement is signed; the rest is on the bill after the birth, paid by a link.

services.name: Postpartum visit at home
services.story: A postpartum visit at home billed to the family's plan: nothing taken at booking; the midwife bills the plan her own way.

services.name: Lactation visit at home
services.story: A self-pay lactation visit at home, paid in full when booking.

services_shape: clinic, with one long package of care: a client is cared for by one lead midwife (with a backup midwife she has met) from early pregnancy to about 6 weeks after the birth; prenatal visits run as a set series by the weeks, booked one at a time at checkout; the birth itself has no set time: from about 37 weeks the client's midwife and a birth assistant are on call for her at any hour; postpartum and newborn visits start from the day of the birth
questions_before_times: a new client or a current one
which visit: the practice's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
where the visit is: at the birth center, or at home (home visits only inside the practice's area)
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video visit: which state the client will be in
safety_stop: heavy bleeding, a seizure, a bad headache with blurred vision, trouble breathing, chest pain, a fall or a car crash, or a newborn who isn't breathing
labor, your water breaking, or less baby movement
thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or a crisis after the birth
first_steps: Health history, risk screen, the consents and the care agreement
A written price estimate for self-pay clients
A client's records from the last care provider
The owner's OK for a new client
license: optional, and never verified by Rosie: a midwife, a birth assistant or the practice may add a license, certificate or registration it holds; Rosie looks nothing up and never says anything is checked
staff_skills: midwives: prenatal visits, the birth at the birth center or at home (where the state's rules allow), postpartum and newborn visits, and well-person visits (nurse-midwives); birth assistants: births and postpartum visits with a midwife; the lactation consultant: breastfeeding help; only people the owner clears go to homes
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the pregnancy, symptoms, tests, results, the birth or the midwife's name at the birth center (at a home visit the midwife's name stays, for the door check)
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
